finding.title: Point signup_screen_an10_test.dart at the real SignupScreen instead of a decoupled replica widget
finding.rule: TQ-8 (regression test must pin real source behavior)

evidence.quote: // Test strategy: render the SignupScreen (or a structural equivalent) in a

finding.why: The file's only imports are flutter/material.dart and flutter_test.dart — it never imports signup_screen.dart. It instead hand-defines _CenteredCardLayout/_LeftAnchoredCardLayout, minimal lookalikes of the real screen's Center(ConstrainedBox(maxWidth:430)) structure, and asserts against those. A future edit to the real SignupScreen (a 985-line churn-hotspot file) that removes the Center wrapper or changes maxWidth will not fail this test, because the test never touches that code. The sibling file signup_screen_l1_test.dart does render the real screen but never asserts wide-viewport centering either (grep-confirmed: no physicalSize/getRect/maxWidth in that file), so the AN-10 tablet-centering bug currently has zero regression protection despite two dedicated test files existing for it.
finding.recommendation: Import and pump the real SignupScreen with tester.view.physicalSize set to a tablet width, then assert tester.getRect(...) on the actual rendered card; delete the synthetic _CenteredCardLayout/_LeftAnchoredCardLayout stand-ins.
acceptance_criteria: signup_screen_an10_test.dart imports and pumps the real SignupScreen widget
the centering assertion fails if Center(...) or BoxConstraints(maxWidth:430) is removed from lib/features/account/onboarding/presentation/screens/signup_screen.dart
